context: This scene takes place immediately after Gustav Gortash's inauguration as Archduke, while people are still in the Audience Hall. Karlach is present and bitter—she warned the party against trusting Gortash and is hurt that the player even considered partnering with him. Gortash has a history of uneasy pacts (notably with Orin and Ketheric), and figures like Orin openly challenged him during the ceremony, so Karlach doubts he'll ever truly share power or keep promises. Per the synopsis, the player ultimately rejected an alliance with Gortash, leaving tensions high between the party and the new Archduke.
